card.summary: 16 GB free with any QNAP ID, no trial period, no file-size minimum. Paid starts $0.99/month; 1 TB was $4.99/month during beta.

free_tier.stated: 16 GB free with any QNAP ID, no trial period, no file-size minimum. Paid starts $0.99/month; 1 TB was $4.99/month during beta.

egress.terms: No data transmission costs. 'Data transmission is completely free', stated repeatedly and used as the explicit differentiator against S3/Azure/GCP.

record.tooling: QNAP-only API and Hybrid Backup Sync / HybridMount. No rclone backend, no public S3 or WebDAV endpoint. Programmatic access is effectively gated behind QNAP firmware. One subscription plan per QNAP ID per region, which forecloses stacking on a single account.
record.chaining: Proprietary cloud storage service requires QNAP NAS hardware for access without public REST API endpoints.
record.limits_note: Per-unit: 16 GB free; one plan per region per QNAP ID. Deliberately unshardable.
record.reliability_note: Requires QNAP hardware or at least the QNAP account ecosystem for write access; the API is not a general object store.
